comments.author: man2clj
comments.body:
Hello @nuclearsandwich, would it be possible to get an update regarding of when the team can be updated? We are currently preparing a new release and this would be the last step.
 
As for my contribution, it will be pushed with the new release. I will be taking over as the maintainer over @Gabriela-AdrianaLapuste for some of the code in the repository. @shu-beg can approve this if necessary.
 
Thank you very much!
